text_block_list.text:
At the summer training camp, Narita Brian
is showing remarkable growth day after day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *pant*...

Driven purely by her burning passion to run, she tears down
this sandy beach entirely on her own—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Whew. That wraps up
the morning training menu.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll do some self-directed practice this afternoon as planned... Hm?

Since we're at summer camp, if only she had
someone to compete and run alongside her—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer.
What are you spacing out for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

To make the most of this training camp,
I decide to head out immediately and search for a mock race opponent.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hm...? Isn't that the Trainer?
What are they doing all the way over there...?

text_block_list.name: Bun-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
A mock race with Narita Brian?!
No way, no way! I'd just get totally crushed and depressed!
choice_data_list: There's no such thing as a guaranteed win in any race!
There's no such thing as a guaranteed win in any race!

text_block_list.name: Bun-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, that might be true, but...
Urrrgh... What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Blue-Ribbon Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. If I'm going to run with Brian,
it'd be disrespectful to do it before I'm actually ready.
choice_data_list: You'd both have so much to learn from each other!
You'd both have so much to learn from each other!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Ribbon Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...I know what you mean. And I know that's just an excuse on my part.
...I'm sorry, let me think it over.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
.........
Why... go that far?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, they were like this back when we first met, too.
No matter how much I pushed them away, they kept coming back...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are they trying to share my running...?
This painful, relentless thirst of mine...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I guess that's just
their nature as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... When I think about it that way, maybe both of us
are searching for a heat that never cools down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(A run that burns away every ounce of fighting spirit, just as I longed for.
You were the one who gave me that possibility.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My thirst is still right here.
The more I run, the fiercer it grows. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This familiar heat... so much like an afterglow...

Before I knew it, night had fallen
while I was searching for mock race opponents.

In the end, everyone kept turning me down,
and I wasn't able to find a single opponent.
choice_data_list: I wasn't much help after all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's summer, the night breeze is chilly.
You'll catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I know what you spent all day doing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it.
...Once we head back, there are opponents waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I was able to find it.
I realized there's hope even amidst the thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who taught me that.
So...

She hesitates, which is rare for her.
Could it be... is she trying to comfort me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: In other words...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
.........
Whatever. Let's just get back.

Narita Brian let out a small, almost bashful smile,
reminiscent of a young child.
—The next morning, an unbelievable sight awaited me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Blue-Ribbon Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I thought about it a lot, and I decided I at least want to try challenging her.
It's not like a chance like this comes around every day!

text_block_list.name: Bun-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Plus, knowing where my current strength stands is really important!
So, with that said...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian, let's race!!

A huge crowd of horsegirls I had spoken to yesterday
had gathered right outside the lodge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hah...! Is heat contagious?
Every single one of you is burning up out here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not that I'm any different.
Fine by me... I'll take on your challenge with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Ribbon Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Blue-Ribbon Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
You've got a great Trainer on your side.
Honestly, I'm jealous.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I suppose I do.

The passionate galloping footsteps of the horsegirls,
along with the sound of breaking waves, echoed across the sandy shore.
